title: Nursing Home and Terminal Illness Waiver Endorsement Specifications for Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Specifications of the two surrender charge waivers on Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities: the nursing home confinement waiver and the terminal illness waiver.

| Tier | Nursing home waiver included | Consecutive days of confinement required | First contract year in which confinement must begin | Terminal illness waiver included | Certified life expectancy at or below which the terminal illness waiver applies | Highest owner issue age at which both waivers are included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 75 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 75 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 75 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 75 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 75 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes | 12 months | 70 |

**Specification notes.**

- The highest owner issue age is the only figure that differs by tier: 70 on the Ashgrove SecureRate 10 and 75 on every other tier.
- *Example (hypothetical):* an owner who was 72 on the issue date of an Ashgrove SecureRate 7 is within the waiver issue age (75); the same owner on an Ashgrove SecureRate 10 is above it (70).
- *Example (hypothetical):* a certified life expectancy of 12 months is at the figure; 13 months is above it.
